svg.title: 8-bit device register fields with AND clear, OR set, and XOR toggle
svg.desc: Register 11010110 has fields READY, ERROR, MODE bits 5 through 3 equal to 2, reserved bit 2, IRQ_EN, and START. From that same byte, AND with 11111101 clears IRQ_EN, OR with 00000001 sets START, and XOR with 01000000 toggles ERROR. Other bits stay unchanged.
svg.text: Every operation below starts again from 11010110. Results are not chained.
A mask 0 clears that bit. A mask 1 keeps the bit.
A mask 1 sets that bit. A mask 0 keeps the bit.
A mask 1 flips that bit. A mask 0 keeps the bit.
